```{r}
#| label: prep-data
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

### Annual updating steps:
LAST_YEAR  <- 2025   # school year ending in spring of this year
FIRST_YEAR <- 2021
###

###### read csv data (district personnel + district financial/enrollment)
personnel_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/personnel-master-thru2025.csv"
financial_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/slfs_essa_financial_merged_thru2025.csv"

# fuction to keep 12-digit BEDS code as text (keeps leading zero, avoids scientific notation in JSON)
pad_cd <- function(x) sprintf("%012.0f", as.numeric(x))

# Personnel: one row per district x year x staff type
df1 <- read_csv(personnel_url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(is.na(NEEDS_RESOURCE_DESC) | NEEDS_RESOURCE_DESC != "CHARTER SCHOOL") 

# fixed clean data - done already
  # %>%       # drop charters (they have no student counts in the SLFS file)
  # mutate(
  #  TOTAL_FTE = as.numeric(TOTAL_FTE)
  # )

# Enrollment: one row per district x year
df2 <- read_csv(financial_url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    ENTITY_CD = pad_cd(ENTITY_CD),
    YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR),
    PK12_Enrollment = as.numeric(PK12_Enrollment)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ENTITY_CD, YEAR, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Keep all personnel rows, add enrollment where there's a match
raw <- df1 %>%
  left_join(df2, by = c("ENTITY_CD", "YEAR")) %>%
  filter(YEAR >= FIRST_YEAR, YEAR <= LAST_YEAR)

# PK12_Enrollment is stored as text; strip any commas/suppression marks
raw <- raw |>
  mutate(PK12_Enrollment = parse_number(as.character(PK12_Enrollment)))

lab_students <- "Students"
lab_teachers <- "Classroom Teachers"
lab_other    <- "Aministrators, Priciples, Other non-Inst.Staff"

# Enrollment is repeated on every staff row, so take one value per district-year
students <- raw |>
  distinct(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, PK12_Enrollment) |>
  transmute(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series = lab_students, value = PK12_Enrollment)

# Two staff groups: classroom teachers vs. every other role combined
staff <- raw |>
  mutate(series = if_else(STAFF_IND_DESC == "Classroom Teacher",
                          lab_teachers, lab_other)) |>
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series) |>
  summarise(value = sum(TOTAL_FTE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Change since FIRST_YEAR. Rounded and trimmed to keep the page size down.
long <- bind_rows(students, staff) |>
  group_by(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series) |>
  mutate(
    baseline = value[YEAR == FIRST_YEAR][1],   # NA if district has no first-year value
    change   = value - baseline
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(change)) |>
  mutate(value = round(value, 2), change = round(change, 2)) |>
  select(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, YEAR, series, value, change) |>
  arrange(COUNTY_DESC, DISTRICT_NAME, series, YEAR)

# Hand the data to Observable JS
ojs_define(chg = long,
           first_year = FIRST_YEAR, last_year = LAST_YEAR)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Get the data from R and make it usable (transpose it) in JS
shared_data = transpose(chg)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Years from the R constants (works whether they arrive as a number or a 1-item array)
firstYear = [].concat(first_year)[0]
lastYear  = [].concat(last_year)[0]
yearTicks = Array.from({length: lastYear - firstYear + 1}, (_, i) => firstYear + i)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
uniqueCounties = new Set(shared_data.map(d => d.COUNTY_DESC).filter(Boolean)); //for popup

// Save unique districts in selected county
districtsInCounty = new Set(
  shared_data
    .filter(d => d.COUNTY_DESC && d.COUNTY_DESC.toUpperCase() === county.toUpperCase())
    .map(d => d.DISTRICT_NAME)
);

// Set Plot district when page initially loads and after user inputs county
districtDefault = {
  county; // Triggers when county changes
  return "";
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// guard function
// makes a submit and reset button to use after multiple inputs made, see https://observablehq.com/@mootari/inputs-submit

function guard(fn, options = {}, countyView) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "100%",
    justify = "start"
  } = options;

  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };

  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };

  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };

  const submit = htl.html`
    <button ${{disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit}}>
      ${submitLabel}
  `;

  const reset = htl.html`
    <button ${{disabled: true, onclick: onReset}}>
      ${resetLabel}
  `;

  const footer = htl.html`
    <div>
      <hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-content:${justify}">
        ${submit}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

const template = inputs => {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "input-toolbar";

  row.append(countyView);

  (Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs))
    .forEach(input => row.append(input));

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box";

  container.append(row, footer);

  return container;
};

  const input = fn({
    submit,
    reset,
    footer,
    template,
    onSubmit,
    onReset
  });

  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;

  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, {capture: true});
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);

  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;

  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width:${width}">${input}`;

  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);

  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: v => { input.value = v }
  });
}
```

## {.toolbar #print-hide-toolbar}
```{ojs}
//| output: false
// County stays a standalone, live (non-gated) input so districtsInCounty
// can react to it immediately as the user types/selects.
viewof county = Inputs.text({
  value: "ALBANY",
  label: "County: ",
  datalist: uniqueCounties,
  unique: true,
  validate: v => shared_data.map(d => d.COUNTY_DESC ? d.COUNTY_DESC.toUpperCase() : "").includes(v.value.toUpperCase()),
  sort: true,
  required: true
});
```

```{ojs}
//| output: true
// Woven Inputs Form for District Selection
viewof inputSels = guard(
  ({ template }) => Inputs.form(
    {
      district: Inputs.select(districtsInCounty, {
        value: districtDefault,
        label: "District: ",
        sort: true,
        required: true
      })
    },
    { template }
  ),
  {
    resetLabel: "Reset",
    required: true,
    width: "100%"
  },
  viewof county
);
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Auto-submit triggers once on page load to draw initial plots instantly
_autoSubmit = {
  setTimeout(() => {
    const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("button"))
      .find(b => b.textContent.trim() === "Submit");
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.click();
  }, 1000);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Filter data by the district selected (empty until the form is first Submitted)
dd = {
  if (!inputSels || !inputSels.district) return [];
  const selectedDistrict = inputSels.district.trim().toUpperCase();

  return shared_data.filter(d =>
    d.DISTRICT_NAME && d.DISTRICT_NAME.toUpperCase() === selectedDistrict
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
function changePlot(data, width, height) {

  return Plot.plot({
    className: "StudentStaffgrowth-plot",

    width,
    height,
    marginLeft: 80,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginRight: 30,

    x: { label: "School year (ending)", tickFormat: "d", ticks: yearTicks, labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: false },
    y: { label: `Change since ${firstYear}`, grid: true, labelAnchor: "center", ticks: 7, labelArrow: false},
    color: {
      domain: [
        "Students",
        "Classroom Teachers",
        "Aministrators, Priciples, Other non-Inst.Staff"
      ],
      range: ["#4f81a8", "#E08A1E", "#d95c5c"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.line(data, {x: "YEAR", y: "change", stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(data, {x: "YEAR", y: "change", stroke: "series", r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(data, Plot.pointer({
        x: "YEAR", y: "change", stroke: "series",
        title: d => `${d.series}\n${d.YEAR}\nChange: ${d.change.toFixed(1)}\nTotal: ${d.value.toFixed(1)}`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

## Sourcedata, Notes {#print-footer}
* Data Source - Staff data:  [personnel-master-file-statistical-run-2024-25.xlsx](https://www.nysed.gov/information-reporting-services/personnel-master-file-pmf)
* Data Source - Student enrollment data: [slfs_financial_data.xlsx - 2024 on, essa-financial-data.xlsx - 2023 and prior](https://www.nysed.gov/fiscal-analysis-research/essa-and-slfs-financial-reporting)
* "Aministrators, Priciples, Other Staff" is the sum of non-classroom-teacher staff.
* A district is omitted when that year's value is unavailable.
* Charter schools and NYC districts are not included.
